place.name: Passerelle Léopold-Sédar-Senghor
place.description: Passerelle Léopold-Sédar-Senghor, formerly known as Passerelle Solférino (or Pont de Solférino), is a footbridge over the River Seine between the 1st and 7th arrondissements of Paris. Opened in 1999, it was renamed after Léopold Sédar Senghor in 2006.
